verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows cap table management, stakeholder merging, and template-based document creation, but no documented bulk operations feature (e.g., bulk grants, bulk stakeholder edits, batch import/export beyond one-time Excel/Carta migration) that would let an AI-native user act across many items programmatically or in bulk. No API or automation surface is evidenced (openapi probes return 404s), so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
